method: Full reads of five pinned source/header/metadata files with Git blob and SHA256 verification. No runtime hash execution.
findings: MetroHash header exposes32-bit seeded one-shot64/128 APIs and opaque streaming128/256 states with copy/free/steal. CRC variants are gated by HAVE_MM_CRC32_U64. Declarations alone do not prove streaming equivalence or dispatch correctness.

MetroHash helpers directly dereference cast16/32/64-bit pointers for unaligned reads, unlike byte-assembly/memcpy paths in previously reviewed BLAKE2/3. Endianness, alignment and strict-aliasing portability are not established by header comment about Nehalem. Implementation still unread.

Murmur streaming interfaces explicitly distinguish nonmutating const steal, finalise that frees state and independent free. State creation has no seed argument while one-shot wrappers accept seed. Exact initialization behavior remains to be checked in source.

xxhash.c only enables static-linking declarations and implementation macros then includes xxhash.h. Reading this47-line instantiation wrapper does not review the268319-byte implementation header; no extra credit given for that header.

Nested licenses declare MIT for MetroHash, public-domain Murmur provenance, BSD2 for xxHash. This is source-notice review, not a change to repository-level GPL reference decision or authorization to copy arbitrary project code.
BLAKE2 gitignore lists benchmark/selftest binaries and artifacts; these names provide no executed-test or benchmark evidence.
limits: No new production code or benchmark result.
